visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with dark hair and a light-colored tank top looks distressed, touching his jaw with his hand against a plain white background. (2) The scene shifts to his reflection in a glass table as he holds his arms and chest, appearing frustrated with his physique. (3) He points directly at the lens with a serious expression. (4) A close-up reveals a plate of light-brown, round meatballs; chopsticks then pick one up, showing a juicy interior texture. (5) The man eats a meatball, and his expression turns to wide-eyed amazement. (6) The video enters a manga-style sequence with split panels and yellow lightning overlays as he flexes his biceps. (7) High-intensity editing shows a close-up of his bulging arm muscles with red energy effects. (8) He eats another meatball with colorful, swirling visual effects surrounding him. (9) He appears with a meatball as a makeshift eye-patch, flexing again with a comic-style background. (10) He checks a food package in a domestic kitchen setting, realizes it's the last one, and runs out the door. (11) A fast-paced montage shows him running through urban streets and entering a FamilyMart store. (12) Inside the store, he stands at the counter, out of breath, facing a male clerk in a green uniform. (13) The clerk speaks to him with a neutral expression. (14) The man reacts with shock, pulling at his eye-patch. (15) He finally stands holding two packages of meatballs, smiling broadly as promotional text overlays the screen. (16) A final sponsorship card appears with brand logos and product imagery.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main male character (creator), 1 male store clerk.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A muscular Asian man with short dark hair, wearing a grey sleeveless tank top and orange shorts.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Starts with a minimalist white studio background, transitions to a modern indoor kitchen/living area, then to an outdoor city street, and finally inside a brightly lit FamilyMart convenience store with shelves and checkout counters.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A somber, low-pitch piano or pad plays as the main male speaker uses a disappointed, breathy tone to complain about his lack of muscle growth. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX marks a shift. (3) High-tempo, energetic battle-style BGM begins; the speaker's voice becomes more intense and projected. (4) A 'munch' SFX occurs as he eats, followed by a 'sparkle' synth sound. (5) Loud electronic impact sounds and 'zap' lightning effects trigger a new phase with high vocal arousal, shouting 'Lailiao!'. (6) Heavy footsteps SFX and rapid synth risers accompany the running montage. (7) A 'ding' doorbell chime sounds as he enters the store. (8) A second male voice (clerk) enters with a calm, flat, polite professional tone. (9) A dramatic 'cartoon shock' SFX plays as the main character shouts 'Huh?' in a high-pitched, exaggerated tone. (10) The music swells into an upbeat commercial jingle with the main character delivering a fast-paced call to action. (11) Final phase ends with a soft Japanese-style 'sponsored by' voiceover over a brand stinger.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Crisis -> Transformation -> Solution -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video utilizes a high-energy 'anime power-up' trope to promote Hainan Chicken Meatballs sold at FamilyMart. It starts by framing a lack of muscle growth as a problem, then presents the product as the 'energy source' for a comedic transformation. The narrative creates a sense of urgency through a 'sold out' crisis at the store before concluding with a clear purchase instruction.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct presentation of the product, store location (FamilyMart), and concluding promotional text with price and purchase location.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video heavily relies on cultural markers like manga overlays and Dragon Ball-esque power-up sequences to target a fitness and Gen-Z/Millennial audience.
